title: Roasted Beet & Edamame Salad with Sesame-Ginger Vinaigrette

steps.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, peel, and cut beets into ½-inch cubes. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, then toss to coat. Spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated), and roast, stirring halfway through, until beets are fork-tender, about 25 minutes.
Meanwhile, place edamame in a colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain further.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place in a medium bowl along with vinegar, soy sauce, oil, and maple syrup. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Chop chives into small pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
When the beets are done, carefully transfer to the bowl with the dressing. Add edamame and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between bowls and enjoy!
